newsitem.title: USA: LPC-United Stationers taps Chase for $540 mln loan.
newsitem.headline: LPC-United Stationers taps Chase for $540 mln loan.

text.p: NEW YORK, Nov 6 (LPC) - Chase Manhattan Corp has completed syndication of a $540 million bank loan backing United Stationers Inc in conjunction with the company's acquisition of Lagasse Bros, according to a Securities and Exchange Commission filing.
The loan is structured as a $325 million revolver, a $150 million amortizing term loan and a $65 million "B" term loan, according to the filing.
The first two tranches of the deal run five years and the third tranche runs seven years, according to the filing.

Pricing starts at 250 basis points over the London Inter-Bank Offered Rate (LIBOR) on the revolving and "A" term loan tranches, and 300 basis points over LIBOR on the "B" term loan, according to the filing.
Pricing can step down, depending on the borrower's leverage ratio.
The deal amends and restates a $525 million credit taken out in March 1995 that came in conjunction with the Illinois-based company's merger with Associated Stationers, according to lenders.
That loan had starting pricing of 275 to 325 basis points over LIBOR, lenders said.
